answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the gale forfeiture reveals up in the nadir totals with the ivory audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 38% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 205 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
